dx_raw:
DIAGNOPSIS: Drug-induced oculogyric crisis, most likely secondary to paroxetine or trazodone

Alternative considerations:
1. Early multiple system atrophy (MSA-P) - given putaminal atrophy, rim sign, and SWI hypointensity, though parkinsonism and autonomic dysfunction not yet evident
2. Neurodegeneration with brain iron accumulation (NBIA) - given SWI hypointensity in basal ganglia
3. Wilson's disease - basal ganglia changes can occur, though typically different pattern
